$description: Per-theme mega-menu colors, pushed into Penpot's theme/light and theme/dark sets by build-penpot-tokens.js. Same reason as buttonColors.json: a token living only inside the Penpot file is deleted by the next import, and the Mega-menu board binds to these. Names are emitted verbatim, NOT under the color.* prefix. blocks/main-nav.css computes these live with color-mix(); the hexes below are the flattened result and drift if the palette moves. Two colors the panel uses are deliberately absent because they are already real tokens: color.text and color.orange.500.
